name: SikaCeram-690 Elite
paste:
SIKACERAM®-690 ELITE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaCeram®-690 Elite, December 2025, Version 07.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sikaceram-690-elite.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaCeram®-690 Elite where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 07.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaCeram®-690 Elite is a high performance cementitious, fast setting, wall / floor tile grout for use in joints from 1 mm to 10 mm in width.
    - Especially designed for grouting fully porcelain, glass, ceramic and natural stones sensitive to discoloration. SikaCeram®-690 Elite has increased color consistency, very good flank adhesion and increased abrasion resistance.
    - For indoor and outdoor use including pools.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Grouting the following tile types .
    - Artificial stone tiles
    - Fully vitrified tiles
    - Glass tiles
    - Glazed ceramic tiles
    - Marble and other natural stones sensitive to discolouration
    - Mosaic tiles
    - Porcelain tiles
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Grouting tiles for the following applications.
    - Balconies
    - Bathrooms
    - Commercial environments
    - Facades
    - Heated floors (Water and electric systems)
    - Terraces
    - Pools and spas
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.12.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaCeram®-690 Elite
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A high performance cementitious wall / floor tile grout for joints 1 mm to 10 mm.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 07.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13007: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product declaration (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Grout joint range: 1–10 mm
    - Fast setting, walkable after 3 hours
    - Floor and wall application
    - DUST LESS® Technology reducing the airborne during during the mixing phase by up to 80%
    - Available in many colours
    - Synthetic resin-modified
    - Very smooth and fine visual appearance
    - Water and dirt-repellent
    - Low shrinkage
    - Flexible
    - High abrasion resistance
    - Frost proof
    - Exceptional colour consistency
    - Good durability and hardness
    - Stain resistant and easy to clean
    - Low in cromate according to REACH
    - Very Low VOC EMICODE EC1PLUS
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polymer modified, Portland cement based, with selected fine silica/quartz sand, water retainers and other special additives.
    - Appearance and colour: Fine powder
    - Product declaration: CG2WA according to EN 13007
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 kg bag
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production.
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 07.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Check joints are dry, clean, clear of excess adhesive, contaminants and tile joint spacers. Remove from joint before grout application.
    - Avoid any ponding / standing water on the surface.
    - Surface must not be damp to touch.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 07.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 1.4–1.45 litres of water per 5 kg of powder
    - Pot Life: ~30 minutes at +20 °C
4.3 Consumption. Quanity of grout required per kg/m² per joint width.
    | Tile Size | 1mm | 3mm | 6mm | 10mm |
    | 20x20x5mm | 1.1kg | 3kg | 5kg |
    | 200x200x8mm | 0.2kg | 0.5kg | 1.2kg | 1.5kg |
    | 300x300x8mm | 0.1kg | 0.4kg | 0.7kg | 1.0kg |
    | 300x600x8mm | 0.1kg | 0.3kg | 0.5kg | 0.7kg |
    | 600x600x8mm | 0.1kg | 0.2kg | 0.4kg | 0.5kg |
    | Coverage should strictly be taken as a guide only. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    The coverage of the grout will vary depending upon the texture, size, and thickness of the tile and width of the grout joint.
4.4 Applied product ready for use.
    | Use | Waiting time |
    | Pedestrian traffic | ~3 hours |
    | Full traffic | ~7 days |
    Values determined in laboratory conditions: +23 °C ± 2 °C, R.H. 50 % ± 5 %. Note: Higher temperatures will reduce the waiting time, lower temperatures increase waiting time.
4.5 Equipment.
    - Mixing equipment
    - Electric single paddle mixer (600 rpm) with spiral, helix, hoop, basket, impellor paddle
4.6 Equipment - Application equipment.
    - Grout spreader
    - Squeegee
    - Grouting float/trowel.
    - Sponge
    - Soft cloth
    - Grout finishing tool
    Do not mix grout by hand.
4.7 Important. Avoid over-mixing to minimise air entrainment.
4.8 Important. Do not add additional water into the mixed product during or after mixing.
4.9 Important.
    - Do not exceed the recommended amount of water in the mix. The mix must never be fluid 1. Pour the recommended amount of clean cold water into a clean mixing container. 2. Gradually add powder to the water while mixing. 3. Mix thoroughly until a uniformly coloured, smooth mix is achieved. 4. Do not mix for 2–3 minutes to allow mixed product to ‘mature’. 5. Remix for ~30 seconds
    - Grout may need re-stirring during its potlife. Re-stir only without adding additional water.
4.10 Application. 1. Apply SikaCeram®-690 Elite using a grout spreader, squeegee or grouting float/trowel. 2. Completely fill and compact the joints uniformly. 3. If required, finish grout with a grout finishing tool while grout is wet. 4. Using the same spreader/ float, remove excess grout from the tile surfaces, moving the tool diagonally across the joints. 5. When the grout is touch dry (15–45 minutes depending on the absorbency of the tile). Use a damp sponge or sponge float to clean the tile surfaces. Clean sponge regularly with clean water. Ensure the sponge is not dripping wet after rinsing. 6. When grout has set hard enough in the joint (finger-nail hard). Polish the tile surfaces by wiping with a clean, soft dry cloth.
4.11 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water after use. Hardened material can only be mechanically removed.
4.12 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Prevent contact of freshly applied material with water (including rain), except during cleaning operations. Also prevent exposure with excess atmospheric humidity / condensation or residual moisture in the substrate.
    - Avoid significant temperature variations during application and setting times, as well as excessive draughts, forced ventilation or winds.
    - Excess water and ventilation, temperature variations, application on very porous tiles or on substrates leading to rapid water absorption can result in colour shade variations.
    - When applying coloured grout into joints for aesthetics such as for polished porcelain or natural stone tiles, always carry out cleanability testing on a small area before full application.
    - On highly absorbent tiles, it is advised to thoroughly pre-dampen the surface before grouting.
    - Always apply SikaCeram®-690 Elite in a continuous operation and do not interrupt for more than two hours in the same room or area of tiling.
    - Premature exposure to water or excess water in the mix can result in white efflorescence on the grout surface.
    - Avoid application in direct hot sunlight to avoid rapid drying.
    - To avoid grout removal from joint, ensure grout has set sufficiently before carrying out the tile cleaning procedure.
    - Do not add anything to the product that is not specified in this Product Data Sheet.
    - Always perform a test on cleanability and staining before grouting any type of cladding with an absorbent or porous surface.
    - Always perform a preliminary test when requiring a colour contrast between grout and tiles.
    - The product is not suitable for chemical exposure. Use an epoxy grout from the range of SikaCeram® products.
    - Refer to the technical bulletin for applications externally in hot and windy environments located on the SIkaAustralia website, "working in hot and windy environments with SikaCeram 690 Elite grout".

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C to +25 °C
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C to +25 °C
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.12):
    - Prevent contact of freshly applied material with water (including rain), except during cleaning operations. Also prevent exposure with excess atmospheric humidity / condensation or residual moisture in the substrate.
    - Avoid significant temperature variations during application and setting times, as well as excessive draughts, forced ventilation or winds.
    - Excess water and ventilation, temperature variations, application on very porous tiles or on substrates leading to rapid water absorption can result in colour shade variations.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaCeram®-690 Elite, December 2025, Version 07.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sikaceram-690-elite.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaCeram®-690 Elite, version 05/08/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sds-sikaceram-690elite.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaCeram®-690 Elite - Successful grouting for hot climates, version 10/03/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/SikaCeram%C2%AE-690%20Elite%20-%20Successful%20grouting%20for%20hot%20climates.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaCeram 690 Elite Leaflet, version 30/05/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/SIkaCeram%20690%20Elite%20DL%20Leaflet%20trifold%202024%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
